name: google-pubsub
title: Google Pubsub
description: Send and receive messages to/from Google Cloud Platform PubSub Service.
label: cloud,messaging

properties.name: projectId
properties.label: common
properties.description: The Google Cloud PubSub Project Id

properties.name: destinationName
properties.label: common
properties.description: The Destination Name. For the consumer this will be the subscription name, while for the producer this will be the topic name.

properties.name: ackMode
properties.label: consumer
properties.description: AUTO = exchange gets ack'ed/nack'ed on completion. NONE = downstream process has to ack/nack explicitly

properties.name: bridgeErrorHandler
properties.label: consumer,advanced
properties.description: Allows for bridging the consumer to the Camel routing Error Handler, which mean any exceptions (if possible) occurred while the Camel consumer is trying to pickup incoming messages, or the likes, will now be processed as a message and handled by the routing Error Handler. Important: This is only possible if the 3rd party component allows Camel to be alerted if an exception was thrown. Some components handle this internally only, and therefore bridgeErrorHandler is not possible. In other situations we may improve the Camel component to hook into the 3rd party component and make this possible for future releases. By default the consumer will use the org.apache.camel.spi.ExceptionHandler to deal with exceptions, that will be logged at WARN or ERROR level and ignored.

properties.name: concurrentConsumers
properties.label: consumer,advanced
properties.description: The number of parallel streams consuming from the subscription

properties.name: exceptionHandler
properties.label: consumer,advanced
properties.description: To let the consumer use a custom ExceptionHandler. Notice if the option bridgeErrorHandler is enabled then this option is not in use. By default the consumer will deal with exceptions, that will be logged at WARN or ERROR level and ignored.

properties.name: exchangePattern
properties.label: consumer,advanced
properties.description: Sets the exchange pattern when the consumer creates an exchange.

properties.name: maxAckExtensionPeriod
properties.label: consumer,advanced
properties.description: Set the maximum period a message ack deadline will be extended. Value in seconds

properties.name: maxDeliveryAttempts
properties.label: consumer,advanced
properties.description: The maximum number of delivery attempts for each message. When set to a positive value, the consumer will automatically nack any message whose delivery attempt count is greater than or equal to this value, allowing Pub/Sub to route it to the dead-letter topic without processing it. This prevents infinite redelivery loops when short retry delays are configured. If not explicitly set and the subscription has a dead-letter policy, the value is automatically fetched from the subscription configuration at consumer startup. Set to 0 to disable enforcement.

properties.name: maxMessagesPerPoll
properties.label: consumer,advanced
properties.description: The max number of messages to receive from the server in a single API call

properties.name: synchronousPull
properties.label: consumer,advanced
properties.description: Synchronously pull batches of messages

properties.name: lazyStartProducer
properties.label: producer,advanced
properties.description: Whether the producer should be started lazy (on the first message). By starting lazy you can use this to allow CamelContext and routes to startup in situations where a producer may otherwise fail during starting and cause the route to fail being started. By deferring this startup to be lazy then the startup failure can be handled during routing messages via Camel's routing error handlers. Beware that when the first message is processed then creating and starting the producer may take a little time and prolong the total processing time of the processing.

properties.name: messageOrderingEnabled
properties.label: producer,advanced
properties.description: Should message ordering be enabled

properties.name: pubsubEndpoint
properties.label: producer,advanced
properties.description: Pub/Sub endpoint to use. Required when using message ordering, and ensures that messages are received in order even when multiple publishers are used

properties.name: retry
properties.label: producer,advanced
properties.description: A custom RetrySettings to control how the publisher handles retry-able failures

properties.name: serializer
properties.label: producer,advanced
properties.description: A custom GooglePubsubSerializer to use for serializing message payloads in the producer

properties.name: headerFilterStrategy
properties.label: advanced
properties.description: To use a custom HeaderFilterStrategy to filter headers to and from Camel message.

properties.name: includeAllGoogleProperties
properties.label: advanced
properties.description: Whether to include all Google headers when mapping from Pubsub to Camel Message. Setting this to true will include properties such as x-goog etc.

properties.name: loggerId
properties.label: advanced
properties.description: To use a custom logger name

properties.name: authenticate
properties.label: security
properties.description: Use Credentials when interacting with PubSub service (no authentication is required when using emulator).

properties.name: serviceAccountKey
properties.label: security
properties.description: The Service account key that can be used as credentials for the PubSub publisher/subscriber. It can be loaded by default from classpath, but you can prefix with classpath:, file:, or http: to load the resource from different systems.
